data.one_liner: An R-tree implementation to index and query two-dimensional data in Dart.
data.what_it_does: Provides an R-tree data structure for spatial access methods, indexing multi-dimensional information like rectangles and geographical coordinates. Items can be inserted and balanced via the RTree class and queried using rectangles.
use_when: You need to index and query two-dimensional spatial data efficiently.
You are working with bounding boxes, rectangles, or coordinates.
avoid_when: You need a general-purpose key-value store or traditional database.
You are dealing with high-dimensional data beyond 2D spatial indexing.
strengths: Dedicated recursive R-tree implementation for Dart.
Supports bulk loading and filtering search results.
Includes performance benchmarks and branch factor tuning.
